name: Curiosity Rover, Gale Crater
description: Curiosity at Gale Crater base on Mars, where the ground is a scanned model of the crater and its central mound (terrain/gale-crater.stl) set into the terrain. Shift and Ctrl raise and lower the throttle, which goes below zero to reverse (X sets zero), A/D steer, B brakes. Turn the camera mast using the Animations menu.
